summary: Iteration 2 backend + frontend testing for Billy's Store admin/promos/checkout. 25/25 pytest cases passed. Frontend admin flows (login, dashboard, products, orders modal, promo CRUD, logout) fully validated. Promo apply/remove on checkout works with correct discount computation. All 5 payment methods rendered; Flutterwave correctly hides phone input. Order confirmation with BS- number verified via API (frontend end-to-end place-order not fully driven due to form input handles detaching on re-render — validated indirectly).

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> (dev overlay adds x-source spans inside <option>). Console error only, no functional impact.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add data-testid to admin dashboard nav link (currently generated as `admin-nav-admin` from `it.to.split('/').pop()` for path '/admin' — the fallback for empty pop never triggers). Change to explicit `admin-nav-dashboard`.

OPTIONAL: Add data-testid to Checkout form inputs (prenom, nom, email, phone, address, city, postal_code, country, payment-phone) and to the AdminOrders 'Voir' and mail icon buttons. Currently only promo/pay/continue/place-order have testids, which forced index-based selectors during automation.
OPTIONAL: DialogContent (Sheet/Cart drawer) missing DialogTitle — Radix a11y warning in console.
critical_code_review_comments: admin.py apply_promo: percent discount is computed against category base but the frontend passes empty category_totals (see Checkout.jsx line 67-71 has a no-op reduce with TODO). Category-scoped promos will always fail min_subtotal on frontend until Checkout attaches item categories.

admin.py get_current_admin: returns AdminUser using **user_doc but user_doc may include extra keys (e.g., password_hash, created_at) — mitigated by Pydantic ignoring extras is not set on AdminUser; if user_doc has unknown fields, Pydantic v2 will raise. Confirmed working today because .find_one projection strips _id only. Add model_config = ConfigDict(extra='ignore') on AdminUser for robustness.
server.py create_order does not decrement stock nor increment promo.uses at order creation (only on flutterwave verified path). Manual mobile-money orders never bump promo usage counters.
Checkout.jsx: contact/shipping form fields don't have name/data-testid attributes making testability harder.

success_rate.frontend: 95% — all admin flows + promo apply/remove verified; direct UI place-order not driven due to input handle detachment (backend order creation validated via pytest)

test_credentials: admin@billystore.com / Billy2026!Admin (JWT). Promo BILLY20 (20%, min $100) auto re-created by tests.
seed_data_creation: Test promos created and cleaned up in-test. BILLY20 promo left in DB for future UI checkout tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_billy_store.py — run with pytest. For frontend, admin login/nav/promos/products/orders modal all confirmed working. Promo apply on /checkout confirmed with BILLY20 (screenshot showed -20%, -66 $US).
